title: Deploxa
description: A Vercel-inspired deployment platform supporting 20+ frameworks across static sites, serverless apps and containerized workloads — with an automated AWS build/deploy pipeline (ECS Fargate, S3, EC2), KMS + AES-256-GCM encrypted env vars, real-time logs over SSE/Redis Pub/Sub, custom domains, instant rollbacks and a firewall.
overview: Deploxa is a self-built deployment platform inspired by Vercel. It takes a Git repository and ships it to the cloud automatically — detecting the framework, building it in an isolated container, and serving it on a custom domain with HTTPS. It supports 20+ frameworks across static sites, serverless functions and long-running containerized apps, all from a single dashboard with real-time build logs.
contributions: Designed and built the entire platform end-to-end — dashboard, API, build pipeline and cloud infrastructure.
Implemented an automated AWS build/deploy pipeline using ECS Fargate, S3 and EC2 that detects and builds 20+ frameworks.
Built encrypted environment-variable storage with AWS KMS + AES-256-GCM so secrets are never stored in plaintext.
Streamed live build & runtime logs to the browser over SSE backed by Redis Pub/Sub.
Added custom domains, instant rollbacks and a request firewall.
highlights: Automated AWS pipeline: ECS Fargate · S3 · EC2
Real-time logs via SSE + Redis Pub/Sub

title: Local Reviews
description: A multi-tenant SaaS platform for review management, customer messaging and business integrations. Migrated the legacy Node.js/MySQL + React app to Next.js, NestJS, Prisma and PostgreSQL, built Stripe subscription workflows (plans, coupons, invoices) and added Redis caching for hot endpoints.
overview: Local Reviews is a multi-tenant SaaS that helps businesses collect, manage and respond to customer reviews, run messaging campaigns and connect third-party integrations. I worked on modernizing the platform and building out its billing and performance layers.
contributions: Migrated the legacy Node.js/MySQL + React stack to Next.js, NestJS, Prisma and PostgreSQL.
Built end-to-end Stripe subscription workflows — plans, coupons, proration and invoices.
Added Redis caching for hot endpoints, cutting response times on high-traffic routes.
Implemented multi-tenant data isolation and business-integration modules.

title: Tixstock
description: A B2B ticket distribution platform. Built inventory management and marketplace modules, reusable React components and optimized state with the Context API, integrating REST APIs across seller and buyer workflows.
overview: Tixstock is a B2B ticket distribution platform connecting sellers and buyers in a live marketplace. I contributed to the inventory and marketplace experiences and the shared component system that powers them.
contributions: Worked on inventory management and modules used across seller and buyer workflows.
Created and worked on multiple reusable React components for consistent UI.
Optimized application state with the Context API to reduce unnecessary re-renders.
Integrated REST APIs spanning seller listing and buyer purchase flows.

title: WatchMyWallet
description: A cross-platform expense tracking app with real-time sync, recurring transactions, and per-category budgeting. Built the mobile client in React Native/Expo with offline-first storage, a Node/Express + MongoDB backend with Socket.IO for live updates, and a Next.js marketing site.
overview: WatchMyWallet is a cross-platform personal-finance app for tracking expenses, automating recurring transactions and budgeting per category — with real-time sync across devices and an offline-first mobile experience.
contributions: Built the mobile client in React Native / Expo with offline-first local storage.
Developed a Node/Express + MongoDB backend with Socket.IO for live multi-device sync.
Implemented recurring transactions and per-category budgeting logic.
Created a Next.js marketing site for the product.
